title: Lupin Leads — Website
summary: A landing site for Lupin Leads, built to get contractors to book a strategy call.
overview: Lupin Leads runs Meta ads for contractors. We designed and built its website around one goal: booking a free strategy call.

cover.alt: Lupin Leads homepage: the headline Less Guesswork. beside a dashboard showing a captured lead and a sample executive report

idea.heading: The approach
body: The homepage leads with a short headline and a preview of what a lead and a monthly report look like, so contractors can see how it works. The rest of the page covers how it works, which trades it's for, and what happens on the call.

execution.heading: What we built
body: Design in the Lupin colours, a mobile-friendly build, copy and page structure, booking buttons throughout, and SEO and sharing setup.

gallery.alt: Lupin Leads website on a phone
gallery.caption: Mobile

notes: Screenshots captured from the live site (Nov 2026). Dashboard figures on the site are labelled sample data — never present them as results.
